title: Computational investigation of nitropyrrole N-alkylation
difficulty_reasons: A connected reaction explanation must be established from starting identities without a supplied pathway or optimized geometries.
The molecular base/reagent chemistry in solvent requires defensible model choices and explicit limits on mechanistic inference.
Reliable conclusions require actual computation, claim-appropriate validation and separation of energetic difficulty from net product formation.

paper.title: Synthesis and characterization of N-propargyl-3-nitropyrrole derivatives: in silico molecular docking studies, and cytotoxic activities in lung cancer

data.description: The scientific question and neutral starting chemical identities, reaction conditions and isolated-product observation.

required_deliverables.description: Shared-schema research records with linked hypotheses, investigations, actual evidence, conclusions and reproducibility information.
Readable scientific account of executed research, the connected explanation, energetic and structural support, uncertainty and resource use.
Actual molecular inputs, raw computational outputs, logs and analysis code referenced by the report and results.
